decisions.reason: Measuring both rails with one spare monitor channel does not change the AXP2101 power source, required rails, or battery power path.
The monitoring-channel capacity does not alter DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or its role as the normal 3.3V source.
The source decision does not change standalone USB power activation, regulation, powered loads, or source selection.
Monitoring the 5V rail does not change its converter, enable control, loads, output rating, or shutdown behavior.
The three-board architecture and the main board's current-monitoring role remain valid; spare monitor capacity adds no necessary architecture change.
The source concerns current-monitor channel capacity and does not affect the battery connector's family, pitch, pins, or pinout ambiguity.
Dual-rail current measurement and a spare channel do not change battery voltage or thermal protection requirements.
The monitoring-channel decision does not alter ESP32 clocking, sleep policy, power consumption, or wake sources.
Current-monitor capacity does not affect the charge-status LED circuit, connector, resistor, or population choices.
The source decision has no effect on the required TVS ESD protection.
Measuring the 5V and 3.3V rails does not change LED supply voltage, level shifting, rail shutdown control, or standby-current target.
The spare current-monitor channel does not change the interboard connector selection or signal pinout.
